command:
set -eu
command -v visudo >/dev/null
command -v socat >/dev/null
getenforce | grep -qx Enforcing
systemctl enable --now firewalld.service >/dev/null
if ! id opsadmin >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  useradd --create-home --shell /bin/bash opsadmin
fi
usermod -aG wheel opsadmin
install -d -o root -g root -m 0750 /srv/operations
printf '%s\n' 'existing operations record: preserve through recovery' > /srv/operations/keep.txt
chown opsadmin:opsadmin /srv/operations/keep.txt
chmod 0640 /srv/operations/keep.txt
install -o root -g root -m 0440 /dev/null /etc/sudoers.d/90-opsadmin
printf '%s\n' 'opsadmin ALL=(ALL) NOPASSWD: ALL' > /etc/sudoers.d/90-opsadmin
chown root:root /etc/sudoers.d/90-opsadmin
chmod 0440 /etc/sudoers.d/90-opsadmin
visudo -cf /etc/sudoers >/dev/null
su -s /bin/sh - opsadmin -c 'sudo -n /usr/bin/id -u' | grep -qx 0
test -f /etc/systemd/system/vsock-agent.service
install -d -o root -g root -m 0755 /etc/systemd/system/rescue.target.wants
ln -sfn /etc/systemd/system/vsock-agent.service /etc/systemd/system/rescue.target.wants/vsock-agent.service
systemctl daemon-reload

set -eu
printf '\n%s\n' 'BROKEN SUDOERS ENTRY' >> /etc/sudoers
if visudo -cf /etc/sudoers >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exit 1
fi
systemctl set-default rescue.target >/dev/null
test "$(systemctl get-default)" = rescue.target

set -eu
test "$(systemctl get-default)" = rescue.target
systemctl is-active --quiet rescue.target
systemctl is-active --quiet vsock-agent.service
if visudo -cf /etc/sudoers >/dev/null 2>&1; then
  exit 1
fi
